The '''Azzameen Station system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It also contained a volcanic world.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
